name: MEA Ablation v1
question: Does iterative re-linearization improve targeted reachability beyond a frozen initial control direction under matched intervention budgets?

iterative_mea.direction: recompute projected current margin gradient every iteration

frozen_direction.step_norms: exactly match the realized MEA step_norm sequence for the same sample
frozen_direction.maximum_steps: same number of realized steps as the corresponding MEA trajectory

interpretation.tests: benefit of iterative direction re-linearization under matched intervention norm
